task: codicarium/lc-config#309 production delivery on standard runtime
decision: GO for revised specification and application/config implementation; NO-GO for activation until explicit context, single ownership, exact-head CI, and immutable artifacts are proven

perspectives.summary: The user materially reversed the Kata activation gate and added self-hosted CI; preserve old evidence but use a new pipeline run.
Keep deployment-controller and one codicarium-prod destination; current platform/infrastructure issues own prerequisites and future Kata readiness.
Standard runtime is acceptable only with restricted security, provenance, admission, non-ARC placement, secrets, and network controls unchanged.
Require genuine self-hosted exact-head checks, explicit codicarium-prod context, conflict-free ownership, rollback, and player-path smoke evidence.

external_gates: Publish a supported kubeconfig containing an explicitly named codicarium-prod context in the current owning repository.
Resolve Nexus NuGet authorization if self-hosted application builds continue to return HTTP 401.
Prove deployment-controller prerequisites and conflict-free legacy-owner retirement without implementing platform, infrastructure, or app-config changes in this delivery.
